name: @sentora/vaults-mcp

tools.name: detect
tools.description: Probe a vault on-chain and report which family it belongs to (morpho | boring | upshift_evm).

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: One-call vault preflight: family + meta (+ gates and position with --owner). --vault takes a comma-separated list for batch evaluation.

vault.description: Vault address, or a comma-separated list to snapshot in one call.

owner.description: Include gates/preflight and position for this account.

tools.name: morpho_meta
tools.description: Vault metadata incl. isV2 (V2 detected via gate getters).

vault.description: Morpho vault address (V1 MetaMorpho or V2).

tools.name: morpho_position
tools.description: Owner position. NOTE: maxWithdrawRaw is ALWAYS 0 on V2 by design — not a capacity signal.

vault.description: Morpho vault address (V1 MetaMorpho or V2).

asset.description: Underlying asset (skips a meta lookup when provided).

tools.name: morpho_gates
tools.description: V2 gate preflight: canDeposit / canWithdraw eligibility for a user (always true on V1).

vault.description: Morpho vault address (V1 MetaMorpho or V2).

tools.name: morpho_plan_deposit
tools.description: Unsigned deposit plan (gate-checked; approve if needed + deposit). Non-empty blockers ⇒ do not execute.

vault.description: Morpho vault address (V1 MetaMorpho or V2).

assets.description: Deposit amount in asset units (base units, or decimal with --human).

human.description: Interpret amounts as human decimal units (e.g. '100.5'); token decimals are read on-chain. Default is base units.

tools.name: morpho_plan_redeem
tools.description: Unsigned redeem-by-shares plan. Synchronous but reverts on insufficient market liquidity.

vault.description: Morpho vault address (V1 MetaMorpho or V2).

shares.description: Shares to redeem (base units, or decimal with --human).

human.description: Interpret amounts as human decimal units (e.g. '100.5'); token decimals are read on-chain. Default is base units.

tools.name: upshift_evm_meta
tools.description: Vault metadata: LP token, symbols, decimals, share price, caps, fees, pause flags, timelock.

vault.description: Upshift Financial TokenizedVault address (the API `contracts.vault`, NOT `contracts.receiptToken`); discover via 'smart-yield yields list --family upshift_evm'.

tools.name: upshift_evm_position
tools.description: Owner position: LP shares, value before fees, balance, plus BOTH allowances (asset→vault, shares→vault).

vault.description: Upshift Financial TokenizedVault address (the API `contracts.vault`, NOT `contracts.receiptToken`); discover via 'smart-yield yields list --family upshift_evm'.

asset.description: Deposit asset (defaults to the reference asset).

tools.name: upshift_evm_gates
tools.description: Whitelist preflight: can this sender interact, is this asset depositable.

vault.description: Upshift Financial TokenizedVault address (the API `contracts.vault`, NOT `contracts.receiptToken`); discover via 'smart-yield yields list --family upshift_evm'.

asset.description: Deposit asset to check (defaults to the reference asset).

tools.name: upshift_evm_plan_deposit
tools.description: Unsigned deposit plan (approve if needed + deposit). Caps checked in reference-asset units.

vault.description: Upshift Financial TokenizedVault address (the API `contracts.vault`, NOT `contracts.receiptToken`); discover via 'smart-yield yields list --family upshift_evm'.

amount.description: Deposit amount in asset units (base units, or decimal with --human).

asset.description: Deposit asset (defaults to the reference asset; must be whitelisted).

human.description: Interpret amounts as human decimal units (e.g. '100.5'); token decimals are read on-chain. Default is base units.

tools.name: upshift_evm_plan_redeem

human.description: Interpret amounts as human decimal units (e.g. '100.5'); token decimals are read on-chain. Default is base units.

tools.name: upshift_evm_plan_claim

vault.description: Upshift Financial TokenizedVault address (the API `contracts.vault`, NOT `contracts.receiptToken`); discover via 'smart-yield yields list --family upshift_evm'.

receiver.description: Receiver the redemption was requested FOR (defaults to --owner).

tools.name: upshift_evm_epoch

vault.description: Upshift Financial TokenizedVault address (the API `contracts.vault`, NOT `contracts.receiptToken`); discover via 'smart-yield yields list --family upshift_evm'.

tools.name: upshift_evm_pending_withdrawals

instructions: Read-only Sentora vault tools: discovery, yield analytics, positions, and UNSIGNED transaction plans. Nothing signs or sends. A plan with non-empty `blockers` MUST NOT be executed. Blockers that compare token amounts carry base-unit `available` / `required` (and `decimals` when known); read those, not `message`. Upshift caps and per-tx limits are in reference-asset units, not deposit-asset units. Endpoints/credentials come from server env only: VAULTS_RPC_URL (or SENTORA_RPC_URL/ETH_RPC_URL), YIELDS_BASE_URL (or SENTORA_API_URL), YIELDS_API_KEY (or SENTORA_API_KEY). Tool schemas from tools/list are authoritative; on-chain amounts are base units unless `human` is set; yields API amounts are token units or USD, except fields ending in `Raw` (base units).
